groups.name: A. Read a few numbers, print the answer
B. A loop over the input
C. One character at a time
D. Numbers with signs in between

problems.title: cinema
problems.tech: two numbers in, row and seat out - `/` and `%` do the work

problems.title: kub
problems.tech: one number in, four formulas out; the counts need `long long`

problems.title: clock
problems.tech: a time in, a waiting time out - print it in exactly the right form

problems.title: seq
problems.tech: keep the previous number, the current streak and the best streak

problems.title: remote
problems.tech: read the points one by one and keep the smallest `|x| + |y|`

problems.title: rabbits
problems.tech: read each rabbit's two positions and keep the largest difference

problems.title: sin
problems.tech: read the letters one at a time: the longest run of one letter

problems.title: maxbin
problems.tech: count the ones while reading, then print them before the zeros

problems.title: choco
problems.tech: count the blocks of one letter as the characters arrive

problems.title: abx
problems.tech: read `a`, then the sign, then `b` - `cin >>` can do it

problems.title: circles
problems.tech: read the sum, work out the answer, then look at its digits

problems.title: guess
problems.tech: try each digit 0-9 in place of `?` and check the sum
